h1: BB House Chachoengsao — a budget stay in Paedriw town that's clean, quiet, with a lift and free parking
intro: If you're visiting Paedriw on a tight budget and want a clean, quiet, easy-to-park stay right in town, BB House Chachoengsao (BB House Paedriw) is a name budget travellers in Chachoengsao keep running into. It's a 2-star budget hotel on Chachoengsao-Bangpakong Road in Na Mueang sub-district. The draw is well-kept, clean rooms, a quiet atmosphere, a lift, free parking, and a starting rate of around ฿650/night — which is why it scores a high 9.1 on Trip.com and 9.3 on Agoda from real guest reviews, very strong for a budget stay in the city.

body.html: What earns BB House its high score among budget stays is cleanliness and quiet. Guests repeatedly say the rooms are clean and roomier than expected for a few-hundred-baht rate, the beds are comfortable, and nights are quiet for easy sleep. For a budget stay in Paedriw town, that tidiness plus having a lift is exactly what budget travellers reward with high marks.

The location sits on Chachoengsao-Bangpakong Road in Na Mueang sub-district. It's right in central Chachoengsao, an easy drive to Wat Sothon and the town centre, and within reach of the market, restaurants and the Bangpakong riverside. The on-site parking is free with space to park, handy for self-drivers. Wat Chom Photayaram is about 450 metres away, while Wat Saman Rattanaram and its giant Ganesh statue are a longer drive out.

Rooms come in several types, from a Double with a double bed to a Twin with a balcony. Each room has air-conditioning, a TV and an en-suite bathroom with a hot shower, and some rooms add a fridge and a small balcony. The property has a lift, a 24-hour front desk, CCTV in the common areas and security staff, plus daily housekeeping. Wi-Fi is free in all rooms.
"Clean, roomy, quiet at night and easy to sleep. There's a lift up to the rooms and parking is available — Wat Sothon is a short drive away. Great value at this price."

To be honest, there are a few things to plan around. Reviews note the parking is limited when the place is full — arrive late and you may need to find extra space along the road. There's no breakfast, so you'll head out to eat. As a budget stay it keeps things simple, without the facilities of a large hotel. And being small, rooms fill fast over long weekends, so book ahead.

Overall, BB House scores 9.1 out of 10 on Trip.com and 9.3 on Agoda from real reviews — very strong for a budget stay in central Chachoengsao. Weighed on cleanliness, quiet, the lift, free parking, an easy drive to Wat Sothon, and a rate that starts around ฿650 and rises with the season and room type toward ฿900, it does its job nicely as a stay for temple visits, passing through town, or running errands on a budget — just book ahead and arrive early if you're driving.

faq.q: Where is BB House in Chachoengsao, and is it near Wat Sothon?
faq.a: BB House Chachoengsao (BB House Paedriw) is at 261 Chachoengsao-Bangpakong Road, Na Mueang sub-district, in central Chachoengsao. It's an easy drive to Wat Sothon and the town centre, and within reach of the market, restaurants and the Bangpakong riverside.

faq.q: How much does BB House cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿650/night for a Standard Double. Options range from Standard Double and Double Room to a Twin Room with a balcony. Prices rise with the season and room type toward ฿900 — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does BB House have a lift and parking?
faq.a: Yes to both. The property has a lift up to the rooms and free parking, handy for self-drivers — but parking is limited when fully booked, so check in early or ask about parking ahead.
No. There's no breakfast on-site, but Paedriw town and the morning market have plenty of food a short walk or drive away, which is part of the fun of staying in town.

faq.q: Is BB House quiet and good for sleep?
faq.a: Generally yes. Many guests praise rooms that are clean, roomy and quiet at night for easy sleep — a big reason it scores so high among budget stays in town.

faq.q: Who is BB House best for?
faq.a: It suits budget travellers visiting Wat Sothon, passing through town, or running errands in Paedriw who want a clean, quiet room with a lift and parking at a few-hundred-baht rate. It's a small stay with no breakfast and isn't fancy, but it's clean and good value for a night or two.
